Build clean, exit 0.

Real error: `src/core/settings.js` referenced undefined var `retries` (should've been `env.retries`) — ReferenceError killed link stage. Fixed:

```js
maxRetries: env.retries || 3,
```

Rest was noise: compile spam, tree-shake notes, dedupe passes, 3 harmless warnings (deprecated crypto API, unused export, circular import) — none caused failure.
